text: れいぎを　しらんよ　きみは

structure.jp: れいぎを　しらんよ

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ない on a verb means 'not'; ん is a short, gruff form of it that older men often use. しらん = 'don't know'.

patterns.name: 〜は (afterthought)
patterns.explanation: In speech, the person being talked about can be tacked on at the end, after the main statement. しらんよ　きみは = 'you don't know them, you'.
